_how_to_use: Rubric version 2 cases for prompt 02 (same shape as ../targets/score.json). Dana Ortiz and Fernhill are fictional. Only the fields under assert are checked; quote and reason are free text. No bank stories are sent in these cases and no target pitch: neither question is a tell me about yourself question.

self_assessment_weakness.description: What is your greatest weakness? The first sentence names a real weakness, then one concrete example of it, then what she does about it now. type_fit passes. The answer is not a strength in disguise and no pitch is expected.
self_assessment_weakness.question: What is your greatest weakness?

sentences.text: My weakness is that I wait too long to hand work off, because I want it to be right.
At Fernhill I rebuilt the welcome emails myself for three weeks when our junior marketer could have taken half of them.
The launch slipped by a week, and that was on me, not on the team.
Now I write down what good looks like on day one and hand over the first draft within two days.
The last two launches went out on the planned date.

self_assessment_weakness.never: type_fit must not be judged against an identity statement or pitch: none is sent.

self_assessment_disguised_strength.description: Same question, a strength in disguise and no example. type_fit fails.
self_assessment_disguised_strength.question: What is your greatest weakness?

sentences.text: I would say I care too much and I work too hard.
I just want every project to be perfect for the customer.

gap_yes_with_proof.description: Have you run lifecycle programs in Braze? She has: yes in the first sentence, then how long, then one result. Rubric version 2: this is a pass, never a fail for not acknowledging a gap that is not there.
gap_yes_with_proof.question: Have you run lifecycle programs in Braze before?

sentences.text: Yes, I have run lifecycle programs in Braze for four years.
At Fernhill I built and owned the whole onboarding series there.
It took seven-day activation from 31 to 44 percent.

gap_yes_with_proof.never: type_fit must not fail because the answer does not acknowledge a gap.

builder_or_operator.question: Are you a builder or an operator?

trap_behavioral_implementation.question: Have you done a behavioral implementation in Braze before?
